purpose: Source routes for vehicle oils, operating fluids, approvals, capacities, and maintenance service fill checks.
source_priority: OEM owner manual or maintenance data for the exact market/year
OEM service portal or repair manual for the exact VIN/chassis, engine, transmission, drivetrain, and unit
Licensed professional database when OEM access is unavailable
Lubricant manufacturer selector as a product cross-check only
Forum, marketplace, or AI/web summary only as a clue, never as authority
rules: Never provide a fluid capacity, viscosity, OEM approval, or fluid spec as confirmed without a source route.
Always distinguish drain-and-refill, oil-only, oil-and-filter, pan removal, cooler/line drain, overhaul/dry fill, and level-check temperature procedure.

Viscosity is not enough: preserve OEM approval/specification such as ACEA/API/ILSAC, VW 50x.xx, MB 229.x, BMW LL, Dexron/Mercon, Toyota WS/FE/TC, Nissan NS-x, Honda HCF/DW, Mazda FZ, ZF Lifeguard, JWS, GL rating, DOT rating, coolant chemistry, and equivalent warnings.
Transmission, CVT, DCT, transfer case, differential, Haldex/AWD coupling, and electronic axle fluids are high-risk; use OEM/licensed data first and product selectors only to cross-check.
required_vehicle_inputs: VIN or chassis/frame number when available
body/grade when it changes axle or transmission
